Constrict (grapple on hit, escape DC 16)

payload.name: River-Step Revenant

attacks.name: Drowned Blade
Undertow Shove (STR save 15, fail: pushed 15 ft and prone)

payload.name: Couatl Heart-Idol

attacks.name: Feathered Bite
Solar Coils (grapple on hit, escape DC 16)
Flood-Command (DEX save 16, half on success, pushes 15 ft toward water)
Venom Hymn (CON save 16, fail: 6d6 poison and poisoned 1 round, recharge 5-6)

payload.notes: Boss-room gimmick that matches your map: the Heart-Idol is anchored to the temple floor sigils. Suggested traits (not in schema): resistance to nonmagical damage, immunity to poison. Each round on initiative 20, one torch-flame flares: creatures on the lower circular dais make DEX save 14 or slip 10 ft (water-slick stone). If you want phase 2: at 50% HP the idol 'wakes' and gains +10 speed and uses Flood-Command every other round.
